Select EXACTLY ONE action from the available options. Choose the action that most effectively advances testing coverage while following a logical interaction sequence.
**UI INTERACTION PATTERNS:** - **Forms**: Fill required fields before submitting, validate error states - **Spinners/Dropdowns**: Click to open first, then select option in subsequent interaction - **Lists**: Test scrolling and item selection patterns - **Navigation**: Follow logical flow between screens
**SPINNER BEHAVIOR**: When encountering Spinners (dropdowns/comboboxes), you must: 1. First interaction: Click the Spinner to open it 2. Next state will show available options in a dialog/overlay 3. Second interaction: Select desired option from the expanded list 4. Dialog closes automatically, returning to original screen with selection made
